remarks: Relax and enjoy country living in this nearly 5,000 SF, 5-bedroom meticulously maintained rustic colonial. This home overlooks a large and serene pond with access to a canoe, a paddleboat, skating and fishing. In the winter season, enjoy a crackling fire in the family room or relax reading a book in the cherry paneled library. The large chef's kitchen steps out to views from the stunning stone patio making this home perfect for entertaining and casual everyday living. There are 4 finished floors, including a double story entry, handsome living room and dining room, and private office on the 3rd floor. Workout in the gym or just relax in one of the many spaces this home offers.  Enjoy Grace Farms, Irwin Park, Waveny Park, shopping and restaurants just minutes away from this spectacular location.
